name: e2e-tests
description: E2E tests for the frontend app using Cypress

scripts.test:e2e:wait: node -r dotenv/config -e "console.log('SERVER_DOMAIN=' + process.env.SERVER_DOMAIN + ', API_DOMAIN=' + process.env.API_DOMAIN); require('child_process').execSync('wait-on --verbose http://' + process.env.SERVER_DOMAIN + ' http://' + process.env.API_DOMAIN, {stdio: 'inherit'})"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:up && npm run test:e2e:wait && cypress run && npm run test:e2e:down
